description: This file defines the 'Upload' class within the Opencart.Catalog.Model.Tool namespace. The class contains methods related to managing file uploads, such as adding a new upload and retrieving upload details by code. It interacts with the database to store and fetch upload information.

classes.name: Upload
classes.description: Class responsible for handling file upload records, including adding new uploads and retrieving upload details using a code.

methods.name: addUpload
methods.description: Creates a new upload record in the database with given name and filename, generating a unique code for the upload.

methods.name: getUploadByCode
methods.description: Retrieves an upload record from the database based on the provided upload code.
